title: Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance — Billing Holds in a Renewal Claim
content:
Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), a billing hold on the held account takes off the amount in question on it from the medical debt a renewal claims, leaving aside every liability posted from the claim under appeal.

**Definitions**
- *Held account*: the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account on a billing hold for a charge dispute or, when no account is on such a hold, the account on a billing hold for an itemization review (when several accounts qualify, the one listed first among the patient's accounts).
- *Claim under appeal*: the Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) claim named by the most recent appeal filed on any of the patient's claims (on a same-day tie, the appeal listed first in the claim activity), while that claim is in appealed status.
- *Disputed line*: the charge line named by the most recent charge-dispute inquiry on the held account (on a tie in creation time, the inquiry listed first); when no such inquiry names a charge line, that charge is 0.00.
- *Twelve months*: For this rule a posting belongs to the twelve months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posting date from the signing day; a whole month runs from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it, so a posting dated on the signing day's day of the month twelve months earlier is already outside.

**Input - judgement - output**

| Input | Judgement | Output (taken off) |
|---|---|---|
| held account on a charge-dispute hold | charge of the disputed line compared with the held account's patient liabilities of the twelve months, claim-under-appeal postings left aside | the smaller of the two |
| no charge-dispute hold; held account on an itemization-review hold | coinsurance liabilities of the twelve months on it, claim-under-appeal postings left aside | that coinsurance |
| no account on either hold | — | nothing |

**Hypothetical.** Charge-dispute hold; disputed line 1,200.00; held account's liabilities of the twelve months 1,000.00, of which 300.00 were posted from the claim under appeal: the cap is 700.00, and 700.00 is taken off.
